symbols.name: BearerSecurityRequirementDocumentTransformer
symbols.summary: Configures Bearer token security requirements for the OpenAPI document.
symbols.remarks: This transformer adds HTTP Bearer token authentication to the OpenAPI specification, enabling API clients and documentation tools (such as Scalar) to support authentication through JWT bearer tokens. Key responsibilities: Adds an HTTP Bearer security scheme to the OpenAPI componentsApplies the security requirement to all operations as the default authentication methodEnables API documentation tools to provide authentication UI and token management References: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79443341/how-do-i-configure-scalar-to-authenticate-through-entrahttps://github.com/scalar/scalar/blob/main/documentation/integrations/aspnetcore/integration.md#authenticationhttps://vitorafgomes.medium.com/how-to-build-a-minimal-api-with-scalar-and-keycloak-authentication-301fde490e40

symbols.name: TransformAsync(OpenApiDocument, OpenApiDocumentTransformerContext, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Transforms the OpenAPI document to add Bearer token security configuration.
symbols.remarks: This method: Ensures the document has a components sectionAdds an HTTP Bearer security scheme using the default JWT bearer authentication scheme nameApplies the security requirement to all operations, making Bearer authentication the default The Bearer token is configured as an HTTP scheme, which is the OpenAPI representation for a JWT supplied in the Authorization header.
